answer: PoA binds each agent identity to an approved enclave’s MRENCLAVE and accepts it only when remote attestation proves that the measured code runs on genuine SGX or SEV hardware under an authorized signer. A virtual machine may copy files or state, but cannot forge the hardware-backed quote; cloning a usable identity therefore requires additional physical silicon, not VM duplication. walnut, nebula, and relic are labels, while the measured enclave is the scarce identity anchor.
